hints.en: Under the check step, `env:` with `APP_URL: ${{ vars.STAGING_URL }}` inside it.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

**.github/workflows/ci.yml**

```yaml
name: Deploy

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    tags: ["v*"]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.13"
      - run: python -m pip install build
      - run: python -m build
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: dist
          path: dist/
  deploy-staging:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: staging
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: dist
          path: dist
      - run: python scripts/deploy.py staging
      - run: python scripts/check_health.py "$APP_URL"
        env:
          APP_URL: ${{ vars.STAGING_URL }}
      - run: python scripts/deploy.py staging --rollback
        if: failure()
```
